correctness.rationale: The occurrences of 010 have starts separated by at least two. Each maximal two-step chain of q starts has exact disjoint packing number \(\lceil q/2\rceil\). Explicit flips of shared zeros for pairs and centers of unpaired occurrences occur at nonadjacent positions and cannot generate new 010; they destroy every original occurrence and match the packing lower bound. Earliest-ending greedy is optimal for equal-length intervals. The 3-state weighted automaton gives the displayed rational series. Coefficient extraction yields radius and deep-hole counts, and exact differentiated rational series yield mean \(n/10\) and variance \(29n/500\) up to bounded errors. Standalone verify.py independently checks all 65,535 binary inputs through length 15 and recurrence coefficients through length 180. Finite tests are corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural constrained source family outside homogeneous run-length limits has an exactly solved Hamming quantization-cost distribution, not just a computable upper bound: exact correction, every finite blocklength histogram, worst-case deep-hole rarity, and a sharp typical-vs-worst asymptotic separation (\(1/10\) versus \(1/3\)). Such finite-blocklength distortion spectra and exceptional-set sizes are directly motivated by quantized constrained coding and are not determined by the usual avoidance word counts.
